hooks.name: verify-after-spec-task
hooks.description: After each spec task, run one clean Maven build. On success the agent gets the 'Tests run' summary and BUILD SUCCESS (so it does not need to build again); on failure it gets the last 80 lines on stderr.

action.command: out=$(mvn -B clean verify 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E 'Tests run:|BUILD (SUCCESS|FAILURE)' | tail -n 2; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 80 1>&2; fi; exit "$rc"
